I Heart NYC — sound credits

The field recordings below were mixed to mono, trimmed, level-matched and resampled.
Loops have short crossfades. Individual recordings retain the licenses listed here.

Hard footsteps — Erdie, CC BY 3.0, https://freesound.org/s/41579/
Water footsteps — AGFX, CC BY 3.0, https://freesound.org/people/AGFX/packs/1253/
Wood footsteps — Mito551, CC BY-SA 3.0. The edited wood clips are distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
Footstep variants sourced from https://github.com/luanti-org/minetest_game/tree/9e895af6e9feb98332fa1a778001442f5669bc20/mods/default

Vehicle engines — nhaudio, CC BY 4.0, https://freesound.org/s/275402/
Bumper and chassis impacts — craigsmith, CC0. Edited takes from the USC optical and magnetic effects collection.
https://freesound.org/s/675466/
https://freesound.org/s/675460/

https://freesound.org/s/848307/

NPC dialogue uses 904 speakers from Piper's English LibriTTS-R medium voice model.
The common greeting is rendered with Piper, trimmed, level-matched and packed as MP3.
The eight original recordings use model speakers 12, 45, 76, 101, 207, 311, 530 and 745.
Training corpus by Heiga Zen and collaborators, restored by Younggun Lee and collaborators.
LibriTTS-R is distributed under CC BY 4.0. Reader labels come from LibriSpeech.
https://www.openslr.org/141/
https://www.openslr.org/12/
https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/tree/main/en/en_US/libritts_r/medium

ONNX Runtime Web 1.20.1 by Microsoft and contributors (MIT).
Bundled license and third-party notices are in dist/vendor/onnx/.
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.20.1
